blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA—Tachiana Mangin could not hold back the tears. The junior world champion had just fallen short of the Asian Games gold medal she came to Japan believing she could win. Instead, she stood on the podium with silver around her neck after losing to China’s Ma Jingyue in the women’s 49kg final Friday. For a moment, the medal felt more like a reminder of what she had missed. “I came really for the gold and fell short. It was disappointing. I’m sorry,” said Mangin, fighting back tears.
